tasks.title: Agree contracts
tasks.classes: Document, DocumentVersion, ChunkDraft, ChunkProvenance, AuthorizationScope, EmbeddingModelSpec
tasks.task: Define typed internal values and bounded API payloads. Extend existing contracts rather than duplicate them.
tasks.done: Example payloads validate; missing/null scope rejects; explicit empty permissions deny evidence.

tasks.title: Create database entities
tasks.classes: CollectionRecord, DocumentRecord, DocumentVersionRecord, IndexRevisionRecord, DocumentAclRecord, ChunkRecord, EmbeddingRecord, IngestionJobRecord
tasks.task: Define tenant-qualified relationships, immutable versions, staging revisions, vector compatibility, job state and constraints.
tasks.done: Models have reviewed relationships, unique/check constraints, and timezone-aware fields.

tasks.title: Connect Alembic
tasks.task: Connect target_metadata to ORM models. Preserve existing revision history. Choose compatible vector storage.
tasks.done: Upgrade a disposable PostgreSQL/pgvector DB; verify tables, constraints and metadata.

tasks.title: Implement scoped repositories
tasks.task: Short parameterized transactions; tenant/collection/ACL/lifecycle scope required on every lookup/search.
tasks.done: Real DB tests prove cross-tenant isolation and denied lookup behavior.

tasks.title: Validate source files
tasks.task: Read only approved restricted-root files. Validate actual format, size, dates, metadata, checksum.
tasks.done: Valid file accepted; traversal, missing/oversized file rejected.

tasks.title: Extract text
tasks.task: UTF-8 extraction retaining source identity, block ordering and locations. Start with one circular.
tasks.done: English/Hindi/Odia text intact; empty/malformed source handled.

tasks.title: Clean conservatively
tasks.task: NFC and limited whitespace cleanup; preserve originals, Indic joiners, numbers, negation and provenance.
tasks.done: Reviewed fixtures demonstrate no loss of meaning or source mapping.

tasks.title: Implement chunking
tasks.task: Use selected embedding tokenizer. Bound tokens including headers/special tokens; overlap and oversized sentence/table fallback.
tasks.done: Every chunk fits full input budget and maps to source; select model/tokenizer before this step.

tasks.title: Implement embeddings
tasks.task: Pinned query/document transforms, ordered batches, finite vectors, correct dimensions; bounded inference concurrency.
tasks.done: Real document and query vectors match full model specification. Fake vectors only in tests.

tasks.title: Persist staged index
tasks.task: Compose extraction→cleaning→chunking→embedding. Write to staging revision; compute outside DB transactions.
tasks.done: Partial writes never become searchable; unique writes support safe retry.

tasks.title: Publish atomically
tasks.task: Verify completeness/quality/approval/model compatibility; activate expected revision atomically.
tasks.done: Failed replacement preserves previous published content; stale concurrent activation rejected.

tasks.title: Execute durable jobs
tasks.task: Persist queue; claim lease, heartbeat, checkpoint, retry and finalize with ownership token; separate worker process.
tasks.done: Restart safe; no duplicate writes; expired worker cannot publish; conflicting idempotency payload rejects.

tasks.title: Register ingestion APIs
tasks.task: Authenticate service and scoped submissions/status; wire durable pipeline/worker via dependencies.
tasks.done: Swagger submission creates job; worker completes publication; status is scoped.

tasks.title: Build vector baseline
tasks.task: Exact authorized vector SQL first. Embed query with pinned collection model; include source references.
tasks.done: Correct circular returned; unauthorized chunks absent before candidate selection.

tasks.title: Register retrieval API
tasks.task: Validate trusted scope and bounded input; return evidence/outcomes/request ID, never generated answers.
tasks.done: Missing scope rejects; empty scope does not search; returned sources retain provenance.

tasks.title: Measure baseline
tasks.task: Begin reviewed questions early; evaluate ≥100 before release. Stable passage/version labels and fixed configuration.
tasks.done: Recall@5/10/20, MRR and language slices recorded; abstention separate; no fabricated results.

tasks.title: Improve retrieval
tasks.task: Vector vs lexical vs hybrid; optional bounded reranking after candidate coverage is measured.
tasks.done: Each variant reports baseline→change→metric→decision plus latency and regressions.

tasks.title: Integrate Java answers
tasks.task: Java owns permissions, facts, final context/token budget, model call and output validation. Treat evidence as untrusted.
tasks.done: Supported cited answer or explicit no-answer; model outage returns authorized sources.

tasks.title: Complete product surfaces
tasks.classes: Parent UI, admin status/publication, AuthorizedSourceService, FeedbackService
tasks.task: Source previews reauthorized, admin sees active index version, feedback linked to request/config.
tasks.done: School staff and parents complete usable workflows with failure states.

tasks.title: Validate release
tasks.task: Verify capacity, ACL revocation, reindex rollback, deletion, backups/restore; security/logging accompany all earlier work.
tasks.done: Release gates demonstrated. Six passing scaffold tests alone do not prove production readiness.
